Activate 1 (manipulate)

Your senses sharpen and your mind floods with tactical opportunities, overwhelming your foes—though the rush of possibilities can overwhelm you instead.

Benefit You gain a +3 item bonus to skill checks to [[/act disarm]], [[/act grapple]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], and [[/act trip]], and your melee Strikes deal 1d6 additional precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] creatures. When you succeed at a melee attack roll, the target is off-guard to your next attack roll against it before the start of your next turn.

The duration is 1 hour.

Drawback You take a –2 penalty to Will saves, Intelligence-based skill checks, and skill checks to [[/act sense-motive]]. When you fail at a melee attack roll, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} until the end of your next turn.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
